notes: All 13 Penn clubs in the batch were checked: one directory fetch each (13 fetches) plus one fetch of each club's own website where the directory entry links one (10 fetches). Two clubs have full records based on dated 2026 items on their own sites: Wharton Undergraduate Aerospace Club (February 2026 symposium) and the Wharton-Weitzman Future of Cities Forum (conference on February 20, 2026). The other 11 are held back with status unknown. Items for the owner to decide: (1) Wharton Undergraduates in Public Policy: the directory says applications re-open in Fall 2026, but the club site does not confirm it, so it is held back. (2) Wharton Women: the directory mentions a 2026 award that the site does not show, so it is held back. (3) Wharton Undergraduate Sports Business Club: newest dated item is Fall 2024, about two years old, so it is held back. (4) Wharton Undergraduate Consulting Club: only the home page was fetched; /events and /joinus may hold fall 2026 recruiting. (5) Wharton Undergraduate Real Estate Club: its website returned HTTP 404 (not a block). No WebSearch was used and no pages were blocked. Individual student emails, co-president emails and roster emails from the directory were not recorded.
